name: Oozera Sakura
source:
An apprentice patissier who lives and works at Primrose, a pastry store tucked away in a residential area.

She and the protagonist are childhood friends, having been in the same class in elementary, middle, and high school. However, after entering high school, they gradually became estranged as their conversation became less and less.

Originally, she wanted to be a voice actor, but her dream was dashed and she decided to become a confectioner, her second favorite job. After graduating from high school, she studied French confectionery techniques at a confectionery school.

She fell in love with the chef patissier Chiharu of "Primrose" where she works, and looks up to her as her mentor.

Her treasures are her LD boxes and LD decks of anime that have not been released on DVD. She meets the protagonist again, who is at a loss, and asks him if he would like to work at the store where she works.

[From [url=http://www.studio-74.net/works/works-patisserie.html]official site[/url]]
